tei:div.tei:p: )snang ba mtha' yas 'od dpag med// spyan ras gzigs dbang padma 'byung*// rje 'bangs nyer lnga grub pa'i rgyal// rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud par bcas// mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol// nang gi bar chad nang du sol// gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol// yi dam dbang chen rgyud sde bzhi// sgrol ma phag mo rigs lnga'i tshogs// ye shes las grub ma mkha' 'gror// mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol// nang gi bar chad nang du sol// gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol// dpal mgon sngags bdag phyag bzhi pa// ma mo sngags srung dbyings kyi yum// pho rgyud mo rgyud dam can tshogs// chos skyong srung ma thams cad la// mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol// nang gi bar chad nang du sol// gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol// rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru rje// chos skyong kun 'dus gu ru rje// rje btsun padma 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rje// byin gyis rlobs shig padma 'byung*// mos gus gdung ba'i bu rnams la// sgrib med mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis gzigs// thugs rje'i mnga' bas dgongs pas mkhyen// tshad med bde bas byin chen phob// 'jigs brgyad dus min 'chi ba zlog /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mi mthun tshogs kun zhi gyur cig /tshe dang bsod nams 'dod pa'i tshogs// chos dang bstan pa dar zhing rgyas// khams gsum srid pa dbang 'dus shing*// bdag gi bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /gnod byed gdon bgegs 'tshe ba'i rkyen// ma lus med cing brlag gyur cig /ma hā gu rus byin gyis rlobs// lus la byin rlabs bde ba phob// 'chi med 'grub par mdzad du gsol// ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang*// bden pa 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// sems la ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*// sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas// rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med kyi// mchog gi go 'phang myur thob shog
ces bsgom sde nang chen pa'i sde pha tshe dbang phrin las kyi thugs dam du rig 'dzin chen po stag sham nus ldan rdo rjes bsgrigs pa'o/// /
